map.📚 深度解析：精密度公差比 (P/T): 📚 Deep Dive: Precision to tolerance ratio (P/T)
map.P/T = 6*sigma_measure / 公差（或 GRR/公差）。例：G: P/T = 6*sigma_measure / tolerance (or GRR/tolerance). Example: GRR=0.004, tolerance 0.1 gives P/T=24%.
map.PTR=6×0.15/6=0.150，略高于 0.1 的推荐上限，量具精度对这条: PTR = 6 x 0.15/6 = 0.150, slightly above the recommended upper limit of 0.1; the gage precision is tight for this tolerance, so move to higher-precision equipment.
map.P/T<10% 优，10-30% 视情况，>30% 不可接受。: P/T below 10% is good, 10-30% depends on the situation, above 30% is unacceptable.
map.分母一为公差一为总变异。: One uses tolerance as the denominator, the other total variation.
